title: Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs Tier Schedule: Filter Supply and Filter Changes
content:
## Filter supply and filter change content by tier

The following schedule fixes, for each tier of the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs, the filter grade the program supplies, the filter sets included for each covered unit in a program year, the number of filter change visits the company makes in a year, and the charges and inclusions that attach to filter supply.

| Tier | Filter grade supplied (MERV) | Filter sets included per covered unit per program year | Filter change visits per year by the company | Used filter removal and disposal included | Price of one further filter set beyond the included sets (USD) | Shipping of filter sets to the site included | Shipping charge per delivery where not included (USD) | Drive belts changed at a filter visit included |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Filter Supply Program | 8 | 4 | 0 | No | 48 | No | 65 | No |
| Managed Filtration Program | 11 | 4 | 4 | Yes | 44 | Yes | 0 | Yes |
| Coil Hygiene Program | 11 | 4 | 4 | Yes | 44 | Yes | 0 | Yes |
| Air Quality Monitoring Program | 13 | 6 | 6 | Yes | 72 | Yes | 0 | Yes |
| UV & Purification Service Program | 13 | 6 | 6 | Yes | 68 | Yes | 0 | Yes |
| Certified Indoor Air Quality Program | 14 | 12 | 12 | Yes | 62 | Yes | 0 | Yes |

A filter change visit count of 0 means the owner's own staff change the filters; the program supplies the sets only. At every other tier the company changes the filters at the number of visits shown.

## Filter sizes stocked by tier

The program stocks a size class for a tier only where the schedule below marks it stocked.

| Size class | Filter Supply Program | Managed Filtration Program | Coil Hygiene Program | Air Quality Monitoring Program | UV & Purification Service Program | Certified Indoor Air Quality Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard 1-inch | Stocked | Stocked | Stocked | Stocked | Stocked | Stocked |
| Standard 2-inch | Stocked | Stocked | Stocked | Stocked | Stocked | Stocked |
| Standard 4-inch | Not stocked | Stocked | Stocked | Stocked | Stocked | Stocked |
| Pleated cartridge | Not stocked | Stocked | Stocked | Stocked | Stocked | Stocked |
| Bag filter | Not stocked | Not stocked | Stocked | Stocked | Stocked | Stocked |
| HEPA | Not stocked | Not stocked | Not stocked | Stocked | Stocked | Stocked |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The shipping charge is a charge per delivery and applies only at the Filter Supply Program, the one tier that does not include shipping; at that tier the charge is 65 USD for each delivery.
2. The further-set price is the price of one filter set beyond the sets included for the program year, at the tier the program is held at: 48 USD at the Filter Supply Program, 44 USD at the Managed Filtration Program and the Coil Hygiene Program, 72 USD at the Air Quality Monitoring Program, 68 USD at the UV & Purification Service Program and 62 USD at the Certified Indoor Air Quality Program.
3. Removal and disposal of used filters and drive belts changed at a filter visit are included at every tier other than the Filter Supply Program.

## Reading the schedule

*Hypothetical selection.* A building whose units take pleated cartridge filters is served by every tier from the Managed Filtration Program upward, since the Filter Supply Program does not stock that size class; a building whose units take bag filters is served from the Coil Hygiene Program upward; a building whose units take HEPA filters is served only from the Air Quality Monitoring Program upward.

*Hypothetical count.* Under a tier that includes 6 sets per covered unit per program year, a program covering 5 units holds 30 included sets for the year; under a tier that includes 12 sets per covered unit, the same 5 units hold 60 included sets.
